The Gentlemen Brings Sophistication to the No. 1 Spot in This Week’s Top 10

Plus: Tyler Perry’s Why Did I Get Married Again? debuts at the top of the English film list.

* * *

By Ashley Lee and Caitlin Busch

Sept. 15, 2026

Link copied to clipboard

Guy Ritchie’s aristocratic criminal underworld is back, and audiences are tuned in. Season 2 of The Gentlemen rose to the top spot on the English TV list, collecting 9.9 million views. Theo James plays Eddie, who unexpectedly inherits his family’s estate — and its clandestine marijuana operation. The latest episodes see Eddie and his colleague Susie (Kaya Scodelario) growing their business beyond Halstead Manor to the lakeside villas of Italy. Audiences also caught up on Season 1 of the stylish series, putting it at the No. 3 spot on the list with 5.5 million views.

Speaking of Italy, Tyler Perry’s Why Did I Get Married Again? debuted at the top of the English film list, gathering 19.3 million views for its lakeside destination wedding. Written and directed by co-star Perry, the threequel sees Angela (Tasha Smith) and Marcus (Michael Jai White) reuniting the beloved friend group for the nuptials of their daughter, Jasmine (Armani Greer). It turns out the mother of Jasmine’s fiancé (Everett Osborne) is a friend of the group: Roselyn, played by Taraji P. Henson. Elsewhere in the Perry cinematic universe, Season 3 of Tyler Perry’s Beauty in Black claimed the No. 6 spot on the English TV list with 3.3 million views. Renewed for a fourth season, the drama series centers on the hair-care empire of the Bellarie family and their high-stakes world of schemes and scandals.

The Whisper Man nabbed the No. 2 spot on the English film list, amassing 12.7 million views. With Adam Scott, Michelle Monaghan, and Robert De Niro in the cast, the chilling crime thriller centers on a father rattled by the abduction of his son — and the possibility that he might have been taken by the titular serial killer, imprisoned since his arrest. Turning Point: Generation 9/11 came in at No. 3 on the list with 5.9 million views. Why Did I Get Married Again?: Walk Down the Aisle to a Happy Ending

So, what are Jasmine and Wesley hiding? Debrief the threequel below.

By Brookie McIlvaine

Sept. 9, 2026

Link copied to clipboard

SPOILER ALERT

This article contains major character or plot details.

When old friends Terry (Tyler Perry), Diane (Sharon Leal), Angela (Tasha Smith), Marcus (Michael Jai White), Sheila (Jill Scott), Troy (Lamman Rucker), and Mike (Richard T. Jones) get together in Tyler Perry’s Why Did I Get Married Again?, it seems like they’ve outgrown most of their bad habits — the ones responsible for the chaos of the franchise’s previous two films, Tyler Perry’s Why Did I Get Married? and Tyler Perry’s Why Did I Get Married Too?.

After all, they’ve gathered for a happy occasion, which is the comedy’s crescendo ending: celebrating the Lake Como, Italy–set wedding of Angela and Marcus’s daughter, Jasmine (Armani Greer), to Wesley (Everett Osborne), son of Roselyn (Taraji P. Henson), one of the group’s longtime friends. Yet mere moments after the gang reunites, it becomes clear that their Rimowa suitcases hold a lot more baggage than just black-tie attire. 

Image: Five adults dressed in stylish outfits stand talking and laughing at an outdoor evening party, with lights, greenery, and a large house visible in the background. The mood is friendly and festive.

Secret relationships and mistakes threaten to spill over and derail the entire weekend. True to the franchise’s tradition, the friends take turns airing each other’s dirty laundry, rehashing old wounds, and litigating fresh missteps. 

As they stumble — and even make some choices identical to their parents’ decisions decades earlier — Angela, Marcus, Terry, Diane, Sheila, and Troy start to give their younger selves some grace. The gang will always be plagued by the dramedy’s titular question, but now it’s time for a new generation to ask the same thing: Why did I get married?

Keep reading to unpack the ending of Why Did I Get Married Again?.

These words of wisdom send Jasmine and Wesley down the aisle in a beautiful candle-lit ceremony. Jasmine and Wesley’s relationship may be far from perfect, but they have the tools — and familial examples — to make it through. When the going gets tough, they can ask themselves, “Why did I get married in the first place?”

### What else happens at the end of Why Did I Get Married Again?

Each couple continues to grow and evolve in surprising ways in the third installment:

Diane and Terry

Diane and Terry have worked through their issues around infidelity and lifestyle differences, and have found a steady equilibrium — maybe even too steady. Early in the movie, Diane hints that things have become a bit predictable. Towards the end of the film, in a sudden break from his typically calm demeanor, Terry stands up to Mike, and then asks Diane, “Is that spontaneous enough for you?”

Angela and Marcus

Ever-fiery Angela and Marcus haven’t fought in years — or so they say. Cracks in their allegedly peaceful front start to show as their son, Marcus Jr. 
### Who is Nick?

Nick is an unexpected wedding guest who turns out to have a deeper connection to the group. We learn that this mystery man used to be Wesley’s middle school tutor — but now dates Wesley’s mom, Roselyn. Only, Roselyn hasn’t told any of her friends about their relationship, and shared the news with Wesley just days before. After witnessing the group’s derisive reaction to Mike’s much younger girlfriend Regina, you can understand why Roselyn has been keeping her May-December relationship private.

Wesley is furious when he learns that Nick has joined the weekend festivities, and lets Roselyn know in a very public confrontation. Roselyn and Wesley’s dad, Harvey, had a complicated divorce, and Wesley still blames his mom for much of the drama. Later in the movie, Nick and Roselyn reveal the true story: Harvey struggles with drug addiction, and every choice Roselyn has made has been in an effort to protect Wesley’s image of his dad. 

At first, Nick’s arrival causes a stir, and Roselyn asks him to leave. But when Nick comes to her rescue during this climactic moment between Roselyn and Wesley, she decides to let him love her.

Why Did I Get Married Again? Cast: Meet the Wedding Guests in Attendance

Inside the family trees, romances, and friendships of Tyler Perry’s new dramedy.

By Ariana Romero and Brookie McIlvaine

Sept. 9, 2026

Link copied to clipboard

There’s nothing like a wedding to bring together loved ones, celebrate new and old bonds, and, more than anything else, stir up family drama. In Tyler Perry’s Why Did I Get Married Again?, the union of Jasmine (Armani Greer) and Wesley (Everett Osbourne) promises to do all of the above and then some, which makes sense given  the gorgeous couple’s parents — and their parents’ friends. 

Jasmine is Angela (Tasha Smith) and Marcus’s (Michael Jai White) daughter, and Wesley is the son of Roselyn (Taraji P. Henson), who is new to Perry’s franchise but a long-time friend of the group. Of course, Terry (Tyler Perry), Diane (Sharon Leal), Sheila (Jill Scott), Troy (Lamman Rucker), and Mike (Richard T. Jones) wouldn’t miss the Lake Como, Italy celebration, with their own kids — Marcus Jr. (Da’Vinchi), Kenya (Laya Deleon Hayes), T.J. (Jaden Michael), and Denver (Charles L. Smith) — in tow.

From the second guests arrive at the welcome dinner, however, salacious secrets emerge, and old behaviors — remember what happened in Why Did I Get I Married? and Why Did I Get Married Too? — resurface, threatening to derail the weekend festivities. It quickly becomes clear that this already very entangled group is even more complicated than they first seem. And when a few outsiders — Nick (Derrick A. King) and Regina (Sydney Winbush) — get tossed into the cauldron of drama, the gang’s antics are lit aflame. 

Struggling to keep up with who is related to whom, and who is sleeping with whose ex? Keep reading to get acquainted with these wedding guests in Tyler Perry’s Why Did I Get Married Again?, now streaming.

Why Did I Get Married Again? Crew Reunites for an Italian Wedding: Now Streaming

The Tyler Perry three-quel gets the iconic cast back together — along with one very glamorous plus-one.

* * *

By Ariana Romero

Sept. 9, 2026

Link copied to clipboard

Do you hear the click of designer heels? Well, that’s the sound of Oscar nominee Taraji P. Henson strutting into the Why Did I Get Married movie franchise just in time for its hotly anticipated third installment, now streaming. 

Sixteen years after its predecessor’s debut, Tyler Perry’s Why Did I Get Married Again? — written and directed by co-star Perry — takes the dramedy’s beloved friend group to Italy. 
The upcoming dramedy is the third film in Tyler Perry’s Why Did I Get Married? series. The original, Why Did I Get Married?, debuted in 2007, and follows four couples on their annual marriage-building vacation. The couples include Angela and Marcus, Terry and Dianne, Sheila and Mike, and Patricia (Janet Jackson) and Gavin (Malik Yoba). Confessions abound as the group is stuck together on their mountainside getaway. By the end of the movie, Sheila leaves a philandering Mike for the kindly Troy (Lamman Rucker). 

Then, in 2010, Why Did I Get Married Too? premiered, following the group on a trip to the Bahamas with explosive —and fatal — consequences. 

### What is Why Did I Get Married Again? about? 

In Tyler Perry’s Why Did I Get Married Again?, the couples reunite in celebration as Marcus and Angela’s daughter prepares to tie the knot. After being apart for quite some time, they quickly learn that as much as things change, they also stay the same. Realizing their children have grown up to be so much like them, they must reflect on the examples they’ve set and ask themselves that age-old question: Why did they get married … again?
